dockerCommands.provider: Local deterministic Pi replies and empty fixture credentials; no network model request.

criteria.proof: Explicit task/allowance input, closed stdin and redirected stdout reach domain controllers without a PTY. Selected repair preserves its owning preparation. Status performs no dispatch.
Version-1 ordered events, one terminal result, stable exit codes, durable reservation/checkpoint before notification, real provider-failure and allowance-pause fixtures, late-event suppression.

Task selection and confirmation produce concrete pending choices, never read stdin or approve; ready checks require explicit review. Repair spend is persisted before request and a second request exceeding the allowance is refused.
Interactive dialogue and guide command adapter use the same operation API; explicit confirmation and caller output routing remain intact.

Public CLI subprocesses use pipes/closed stdin and files for redirected output; real installed Docker runs deterministic local Pi responses. F16 now runs in default suite. Six deliberate defects are caught.

limitations: Protocol covers prepare, selected repair, continue and status. Interactive interviews/review and unrelated platform commands remain separate. Dashboard mutation remains hr-031/hr-032/hr-037.
Events are live notifications, not a replay log or approval/evidence authority. Abrupt process death or a broken output pipe can leave no terminal; inspect retained state before resuming.
Request/time limits are not dollar-cost caps. Cumulative accounting and autonomous bounded continuation remain hr-026/hr-027.
Success describes the requested operation only. A successful status read or selected repair does not certify or approve an application. Choice IDs are not authorization tokens.

Installed runtime evidence is local Linux arm64 Docker/Chromium with synthetic fixtures, not hosted CI, real providers or other platforms. No live blog state, credentials, new dependencies, paid model calls, commits or pushes.
Final documentation evidence and disposable claim are produced after qualification; executable code/tests are unchanged.
repairNotes: The default-skipped Docker stage fixture originally expected legacy exit 0 on approval pending. It was updated to expect decision_required/exit 3 and assert parseable terminal choices, retaining all preview and explicit-application safeguards. The updated fixture was run directly and in final installed smoke; no application source changed after the final full-suite launch.
A guide-adapter regression exposed output bypassing the caller dialogue; fixed before final qualification.
Continuation status retains its prior saved build-attempt details in JSON progress; compatibility test verifies read-only state.
